note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Times are fictional labels. Substituting a time label changes that label only: the stations keep the supplied order, and nothing states when a withdrawal takes effect, whether a message arrived in time, which one prevails, or whether the proposal is revoked or still open.
